title: Model-Free Passive Execution via Order-Level Shadowing
abstract: arXiv:2609.18019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated execution algorithms are organized into schedule-based and liquidity-seeking families. This paper concerns the first, whose members -- Time-Weighted Average Price (TWAP), Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP), Percentage of Volume (POV) and Implementation Shortfall -- are all model-based: each derives its decisions from an explicit model, forecast, schedule or control rule. We introduce Shadow-PPOV, a passive POV whose order-placement rate is set from observed order flow rather than from traded volume. Placing a passive order to fill efficiently conventionally involves an order-book model and a fill prediction. Shadow-PPOV replaces that prediction with tracking: on observing a third-party add, it may transmit its own limit order at the same price on the same venue, recording a single association between the observed order's exchange identifier and its own. translated_title: 基于订单级影子追踪的无模型被动执行
translated_abstract: 自动化执行算法分为基于调度和流动性搜寻两大类。本文关注第一类，其成员——时间加权平均价格（TWAP）、成交量加权平均价格（VWAP）、成交量百分比（POV）和实施缺口——都是基于模型的：每种算法都从明确的模型、预测、调度或控制规则推导其决策。我们提出Shadow-PPOV，一种被动式POV算法，其下单率由观测到的订单流而非已成交量决定。传统上，提交被动订单以实现高效成交需要订单簿模型和成交预测。Shadow-PPOV用追踪取代了这种预测：在观测到第三方新增订单时，它可以在同一交易场所的相同价位提交自己的限价单，并记录观测订单的交易所标识符与自己订单之间的单一关联关系。撤单则由标识符驱动——当原订单被撤回时，影子订单也随之撤回。
tldr: 本文提出Shadow-PPOV，一种无模型的被动POV执行算法，通过“影子”方式追踪第三方订单流的添加与撤回来驱动自身订单的下单与撤单，从而无需订单簿模型和成交预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Shadow-PPOV, a model-free passive POV execution algorithm that shadows third-party order flow—mirroring its own order placements and cancellations to observed order additions and removals—thereby eliminating the need for order-book models and fill predictions.
